name: Sports betting
h1: Crypto casinos with a full sportsbook
metaTitle: Crypto Sportsbooks: Casino and Sports Betting, One Balance
metaDescription: Crypto casinos that also run a full sportsbook alongside the casino games, sharing one balance and one crypto wallet across both.
intro:
Some crypto casinos are casinos with a sportsbook bolted on for variety. Others run sports betting as a genuinely full product — deep markets across dozens of sports, live in-play betting, and odds that compete with dedicated sportsbooks rather than an afterthought squeezed into a casino's menu bar. This page tracks the latter kind.

The practical advantage of a combined platform is a single balance. Deposit crypto once, and the same funds cover a slot spin, a blackjack hand, and a same-game parlay without moving money between separate accounts or separate wallets. Withdrawals work identically regardless of which side of the platform generated the winnings — the casino's payout processing does not distinguish between casino and sportsbook balance.

What varies most between operators is depth: how many sports and leagues are actually covered beyond the handful of major ones every sportsbook lists, whether live in-play markets update fast enough to be usable, and how competitive the odds are compared with a dedicated sports betting platform. A casino that lists "sports betting" as a feature is not necessarily offering the same market depth as one that built its sportsbook as a primary product rather than a secondary one.

Regulatory treatment of sports betting sometimes differs from casino games even within the same jurisdiction and even at the same operator, so a licence that covers casino games does not automatically mean the sportsbook side carries identical legal standing everywhere the casino is accessible — worth checking separately if that distinction matters to you.

faq.q: Do casino and sportsbook balances stay separate?
faq.a: No, typically not — most crypto casinos with a sportsbook use one shared balance across both, funded and withdrawn the same way regardless of where it was won.

faq.q: Is the sportsbook covered by the same licence as the casino?
faq.a: Not always. Regulatory treatment can differ even at the same operator, so it is worth checking if that distinction matters in your situation.
